full_text_zh:
[P1] 老鼠牙医—地嗖头

文·图 威廉·史塔克
译 孙晴峰

少年儿童出版社

[P2] 老鼠牙医—地嗖头

文·图 威廉·史塔克
译 孙晴峰

少年儿童出版社

[P3] 地嗖头是个牙科医生，他的技术非常好，所以病人总是很多很多。跟他的身材差不多的病人，像迷你兔、天竺鼠等等，坐在诊疗椅上，让地嗖头医生为他们看病。
个子比较大的病人，就坐在地板上，地嗖头医生得爬到梯子上，为他们看病。

[P4] 要是遇上一些身材特别高大的，也难不倒地嗖头。他有一个特别的房间，可以由他的助手——也就是地嗖头太太帮忙，把他吊在半空中，为动物看病。

[P5] 人人都说地嗖头医生好，大动物们更是特别喜欢他。
地嗖头医生可以穿着雨鞋，把头钻进动物嘴巴里工作，他
用轻巧的手指、细细的钻子为他们修补牙齿，所以他们一
点儿都不觉得痛。
因为地嗖头医生是一只老鼠，所以他拒绝为任何可能
伤害老鼠的动物看病，这一点，他在招牌上写得清清楚楚
的。每当楼下的门铃一响，他和太太就跑到窗边向下望，
即使是看起来很胆小、很害羞的小猫，也不让他进来。
地嗖头医生
牙科
猫及任何
危险动物
恕不治疗

[P6] 有一天，他们竟然看见一只穿得很整齐的狐狸站在下面，从头顶到下巴绑着一条绷带。
地嗖头医生大叫：“我不能帮你看病，你没看见招牌上的字吗？”

[P7] 地嗖头医生说：“你等一下。”然后小声地问太太：“我们怎么办呢？”

狐狸低下头哭起来：“求求你，行行好，我的牙齿好痛好痛！”他哭得眼泪、鼻涕直流，看起来真是可怜。

地嗖头太太说：“我们就冒一次险吧。”她按下电钮，打开门让狐狸进来。

[P8] 狐狸飞快地跑上楼，跪在地上说：“上天保佑你们的好心肠，快救救我吧，我的牙痛死了！”
“先生，请坐在地板上，”地嗖头医生一边洗手一边说，“把绷带拿掉。”

[P9] 地嗖头医生爬上梯子，勇敢地跨进狐狸的嘴巴里。
“呜——”他简直要透不过气了，因为狐狸的嘴巴实在太臭、太难闻了。

“噢——”狐狸呻吟着说，“做什么都可以，只要牙齿不再痛就好了。”
虽然牙齿很痛，狐狸还是感觉到嘴里有个好吃的东西在那里动来动去。他的下巴忍不住抖起来了。“张开！”地嗖头医生大叫。“张大点！”地嗖头太太也跟着大叫。

“这颗蛀牙要拔掉，”地嗖头医生大声宣布，“不过我们可以帮你做一颗新牙。”

[P10] 地嗖头医生说：“现在我要让你闻一种东西，待会拔牙就不会觉得痛了。”
狐狸很快地进入梦乡，还说起梦话来：“呣，嗯，好香啊，喷喷，我最喜欢吃生的……上头撒点盐巴，再配上一杯葡萄酒……”
他们猜也猜得出狐狸正在做什么梦。地嗖头太太把一根木棍交给先生，撑开狐狸的嘴巴。

[P11] 地嗖头医生用拔牙器夹紧了那颗蛀牙，然后和太太合力转动绞盘，绳子愈转愈紧，终于，“啵！”的一声，牙齿给拔了出来，还在半空中荡来荡去。

[P12] “啊！我流血了。”狐狸清醒过来，尖声叫着。
地嗖头医生爬上楼梯，把纱布塞进拔掉的牙齿洞里，
他说：“最难受的都过去了，明天早上十一点整再来，我
给你装上假牙。”

狐狸的头还晕晕的，他说声再见就走了。在回家的路上，狐狸一直在想：“如果明天地嗖头把假牙装好了，我
一口就把他吃掉，会太卑鄙吗？”

[P13] 下班以后，地嗖头太太忙着磨一颗纯金的假牙。地嗖头医生气呼呼地说：“他还想吃生的，加盐巴呢！我竟然会笨得去相信一只狐狸。”

“他不知道自己在说什么啦，”地嗖头太太说，“他怎么会害我们呢？我们是在帮他呀！”
“因为他是一只狐狸，这些可恶的、坏心肠的家伙。”

[P14] 晚上，他们两个都担心得睡不着。“明天我们要不要让他进来呢？”地嗖头太太问。
“一旦开始做一件工作，我一定要好好把它做完，就像我父亲一样。”地嗖头医生坚决地说。
“但是我们总得想办法保护自己啊！”
夫妇俩谈着谈着，终于想好一个办法。“一定行得通！”地嗖头医生说完，就放心地睡了。

[P15] 第二天早上，才刚十一点，狐狸就高高兴兴地跑来了。他一点儿也不觉得痛了。

[P16] 地嗖头医生刚爬进狐狸的嘴巴里，狐狸就“啪嗒”一声，把嘴巴闭起来，再打开，一边发出难听的笑声说：
“嘿，嘿，我只是开个玩笑。”

“正经点！”地嗖头医生严厉地说，“我们还有事要做，哪有时间跟你开玩笑！”
地嗖头太太抱着纯金的牙齿慢慢爬上梯子。

[P17] 狐狸看见了，高兴地说：“哇，好漂亮的牙齿。”
地嗖头医生把金牙齿镶进拔掉的牙齿洞里，再把它和
两边的牙齿套紧。

狐狸用舌尖舔着新牙齿，心里想：“——啊，感觉真
好，我实在不该吃他们；可是，我怎么忍得住呢？”

[P18] “等一等，还没好。”地嗖头医生拿出一个大罐子，说：“我跟我太太最近发明了一种神秘药水，涂在牙齿上，以后就永远不会牙痛。你愿不愿意第一个试试这种独门秘方啊？”

[P19] “我当然愿意，这是我的荣幸。”狐狸满口答应，因为他一向最怕痛了。

地嗖头医生说：“你以后再也不需要来看我们了。”
狐狸心里想：“也没有人会再看到你们了。”他已经下定决心，要用他全新的牙齿把地嗖头医生和太太吃掉。

[P20] 地嗖头医生提着装满神秘药水的小桶子，钻进狐狸的嘴巴。他用刷子把药水涂在每一颗牙齿上，一边做，一边快乐地哼着歌。地嗖头太太站在旁边的梯子上指挥，告诉他哪儿还没涂到。狐狸呢？他安静地坐着，看起来很愉快。

[P21] 全涂好了，地嗖头医生走出来告诉狐狸：“把下巴合起来，咬紧一分钟。”狐狸照着做了。但是当他想把嘴巴张开的时候——牙齿全粘住了。

“啊，真对不起，”地嗖头医生说，“我忘了告诉你，这一两天，你的嘴巴会暂时打不开，好让药水渗进牙齿里。不过，请放心，再也不会牙痛了。”

[P22] 狐狸呆住了，他看看地嗖头医生，再看看地嗖头太太，他们也微笑地看着他。他只好咬着牙说“fi chí xì xì”，然后站起来，假装很有礼貌地向他们道别。

[P23] 狐狸迷迷糊糊地下楼走了。

地嗖头医生和他太太竟然从“狐口”逃生了。他们互相亲了一下，然后放了自己一天假。
full_text_en:
[P1] The Dentist Mouse—Dr. DeSoto

Text and Illustrations by William Steig
Translated by Sun Qingfeng

Children's Publishing House

[P2] The Mouse Dentist—Dizhou Tou

Text and Illustrations by William Steig
Translated by Sun Qingfeng

Children's Publishing House

[P3] Dr. Dizou Tou is a dentist, and his skills are excellent, so he always has many, many patients. Patients of similar size to him, like mini rabbits and guinea pigs, sit in the dental chair while Dr. Dizou Tou treats them.
Larger patients sit on the floor, and Dr. Dizou Tou has to climb up a ladder to treat them.

[P4] If he encounters some particularly tall patients, it's no problem for Dr. Doo-Head. He has a special room where his assistant—his wife, Mrs. Doo-Head—can help lift him into the air with pulleys so he can treat animals.

[P5] Everyone says Dr. Di Sou Tou is great, and big animals especially like him.
Dr. Di Sou Tou can wear rain boots and stick his head into an animal's mouth to work. He uses nimble fingers and fine drills to repair their teeth, so they don't feel any pain at all.
Because Dr. Di Sou Tou is a mouse, he refuses to treat any animal that might harm mice. He clearly writes this on his sign. Every time the doorbell rings downstairs, he and his wife rush to the window to look down. Even a small, timid, shy kitten is not allowed in.
Dr. Di Sou Tou
Dentistry
Cats and any
Dangerous animals
Not treated

[P6] One day, they suddenly saw a very neatly dressed fox standing below, with a bandage wrapped from the top of his head to his chin.
Doctor Dizhou shouted, “I can’t help you with your illness. Haven’t you seen the words on the sign?”

[P7] Dr. Dizou Tou said, “Wait a moment.” Then he whispered to his wife, “What should we do?”

The fox bowed his head and cried, “Please, please, my teeth hurt so much, so much!” He cried with tears and snot streaming down, looking truly pitiful.

Mrs. Dizou Tou said, “Let’s take a chance.” She pressed the button and opened the door to let the fox in.

[P8] The fox ran up the stairs quickly, knelt on the floor, and said, "May heaven bless your kind hearts, please save me, my tooth hurts so much!"
"Sir, please sit on the floor," said Doctor Dizhou, washing his hands, "take off the bandage."

[P9] Dr. Dizhou climbed the ladder and bravely stepped into the fox's mouth.
"Ugh—" he almost couldn't breathe, because the fox's mouth was so stinky and unpleasant.

"Ooh—" the fox groaned, "I'll do anything, as long as my teeth stop hurting."
Even though his teeth hurt, the fox still felt something delicious moving around in his mouth. His jaw couldn't help but tremble. "Open!" Dr. Dizhou shouted. "Open wider!" Mrs. Dizhou shouted along with him.

"This cavity needs to be pulled," Dr. Dizhou announced loudly, "but we can make you a new tooth."

[P10] Dr. Dizhou said, "Now I'm going to let you smell something, and you won't feel any pain when we pull the tooth." 

The fox quickly fell asleep and started talking in his sleep: "Mmm, hmm, so fragrant, delicious, I love eating raw things... with a bit of salt on top, and a glass of wine to go with it..." 

They could guess what dream the fox was having. Mrs. Dizhou handed a stick to her husband to hold the fox's mouth open.

[P11] Doctor Dizhou used the tooth puller to clamp the decayed tooth, then together with his wife, turned the winch. The rope tightened more and more. Finally, with a 'pop!' sound, the tooth was pulled out and swung in mid-air.

[P12] "Ah! I'm bleeding," the fox cried out as he woke up.
Doctor Dizhou climbed the stairs, put gauze into the hole where the tooth had been pulled out,
and said, "The worst is over. Come back tomorrow morning at exactly eleven o'clock, and I'll fit you with false teeth."

The fox's head was still dizzy. He said goodbye and left. On his way home, the fox kept thinking: "If tomorrow Dizhou fits the false teeth, will it be too mean if I eat him in one bite?"

[P13] After work, Mrs. Dizhou was busy grinding a pure gold false tooth. Dr. Dizhou said angrily, "He still wants to eat raw food with salt! I'm actually foolish enough to trust a fox!"

"He doesn't know what he's saying," Mrs. Dizhou said, "How could he harm us? We're helping him!"
"Because he's a fox, these despicable, heartless creatures."

[P14] At night, both of them were so worried they couldn't sleep. "Should we let him in tomorrow?" asked Doctor Disou's wife.
"Once I start a job, I must finish it properly, just like my father," said Doctor Disou firmly.
"But we must find a way to protect ourselves!"
As the couple talked, they finally came up with a plan. "It will definitely work!" said Doctor Disou, and then he slept peacefully.

[P15] The next morning, just past eleven o'clock, the fox came running happily. He didn't feel any pain at all.

[P16] Dr. Disou just crawled into the fox's mouth when the fox 'clapped' once, closed his mouth, then opened it again, laughing unpleasantly: 
"Heh, heh, I was just joking."

"Be serious!" Dr. Disou said sternly, "We still have work to do. We don't have time to joke with you!"
Mrs. Disou, holding the golden tooth, slowly climbed up the ladder.

[P17] The fox saw it and happily said, "Wow, what beautiful teeth!"
Doctor Disou head placed the golden tooth into the hole where the tooth was pulled out, then secured it tightly with the teeth on both sides.

The fox licked his new tooth with his tongue and thought to himself, "—Ah, it feels so good. I really shouldn't eat them; but how can I resist?"

[P18] "Wait a minute, not quite done yet," Doctor Disou Tou took out a big jar and said, "My wife and I recently invented a magical potion. If you apply it to your teeth, you'll never have toothache again. Would you like to be the first to try this secret remedy?"

[P19] "I certainly am willing, it's my honor," the fox readily agreed, because he had always been afraid of pain.

Dr. Disou said, "You'll never need to come see us again."
The fox thought to himself, "No one will ever see you again." He had already made up his mind to use his brand new teeth to eat Dr. Disou and his wife.

[P20] Doctor Disou head carried a small bucket filled with mysterious medicine and crawled into the fox's mouth. He used a brush to apply the medicine to each tooth, singing happily as he worked. Mrs. Disou head stood on the ladder nearby, directing him and telling him where he hadn't applied it yet. What about the fox? He sat quietly, looking very happy.

[P21] It's all coated now. Dr. Di Sou Tou comes out and tells the fox, 'Close your jaw and bite down for one minute.' The fox does as told. But when he tries to open his mouth—his teeth are stuck together.

'Oh, I'm so sorry,' says Dr. Di Sou Tou, 'I forgot to tell you. For the next one or two days, your mouth will be temporarily stuck shut, so the medicine can seep into your teeth. But don't worry, you'll never have toothache again.'

[P22] The fox froze. He looked at Doctor Disou, then at Mrs. Disou, and they smiled back at him. He could only grit his teeth and say, “fi chí xì xì,” then stood up and pretended to be very polite as he said goodbye.

[P23] The fox walked downstairs, dazed and confused.

Doctor Dizhou and his wife had actually escaped from the 'fox's mouth'. They kissed each other, then took a day off.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《老鼠牙医—地嗖头》的封面，展示了主角老鼠牙医站在牙科诊所内，旁边有牙科椅和设备，下方标注了作者、译者和出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《老鼠牙医—地嗖头》的封面，展示了主角老鼠牙医正在为另一只老鼠看牙的场景，左侧页面有一副牙齿的插图，右侧页面标注了作者、译者和出版社信息。
[P3] 本页介绍了老鼠牙医地嗖头，他技术高超，病人很多。身材相近的病人坐在诊疗椅上，而个子较大的病人则坐在地板上，地嗖头医生需爬梯子为他们看牙。
[P4] 本页展示了老鼠牙医地嗖头为高大动物看病的场景：他被助手地嗖头太太用滑轮系统吊在半空中，以便为躺在地上的大型动物检查牙齿，左侧画面显示地嗖头太太在客厅阅读报纸。
[P5] 本页展示了老鼠牙医地嗖头为大动物看牙的场景，并说明他因自身是老鼠而拒绝为可能伤害老鼠的动物（如猫）治疗，招牌上明确标示了这一规定。
[P6] 本页描绘了老鼠牙医地嗖头在街边看到一只穿着整齐、头缠绷带的狐狸，他拒绝为狐狸看病，并质问对方是否看到招牌上的规定。
[P7] 狐狸因牙痛在门外哭泣，地嗖头医生犹豫不决，地嗖头太太最终决定冒险让狐狸进门。
[P8] 狐狸因牙痛跪在老鼠牙医地嗖头的诊所门口求救，地嗖头医生让狐狸坐在地板上并要求他取下绷带。
[P9] 老鼠牙医地嗖头爬上梯子，进入狐狸张开的嘴里为其检查牙齿，狐狸因牙痛而呻吟，地嗖头医生和太太要求他张大嘴，并宣布要拔掉蛀牙并为其制作新牙。
[P10] 老鼠牙医地嗖头为狐狸进行牙科治疗，先让狐狸吸入麻醉剂，狐狸进入梦乡并说梦话，地嗖头太太则用木棍撑开狐狸的嘴巴以便医生操作。
[P11] 老鼠牙医地嗖头和太太合力用滑轮系统为狐狸拔除蛀牙，牙齿被成功拔出后在空中荡来荡去。
[P12] 狐狸拔牙后清醒过来，地嗖头医生为他塞上纱布并约定次日装假牙。狐狸回家路上心生恶念，思考是否在假牙装好后吃掉医生。
[P13] 下班后，老鼠牙医地嗖头太太正在制作假牙，地嗖头医生因担心狐狸的危险性而生气，太太则认为他们是在帮助狐狸，两人对狐狸的动机产生分歧。
[P14] 晚上，地嗖头医生和太太因担心狐狸而难以入眠，两人讨论是否让狐狸第二天来装假牙，并最终想出了一个保护自己的办法，医生安心入睡。
[P15] 第二天早上十一点，狐狸高高兴兴地来到诊所，表示牙痛已经消失。
[P16] 狐狸在牙医地嗖头刚进入其口中时突然合上嘴并开玩笑，地嗖头医生严厉制止，地嗖头太太则抱着纯金假牙爬上梯子准备安装。
[P17] 老鼠牙医地嗖头为狐狸成功安装了纯金假牙，狐狸对新牙感到满意，但内心仍挣扎于是否吃掉医生的念头。
[P18] 地嗖头医生为狐狸安装完假牙后，拿出新发明的神秘药水，邀请狐狸作为第一个试用者，以防止未来牙痛。
[P19] 狐狸答应试用牙医的新药水，但内心已下定决心，要用新装的假牙吃掉地嗖头医生和太太。
[P20] 地嗖头医生正在为狐狸的牙齿涂抹神秘药水，太太在梯子上指挥，狐狸则安静地坐着，表面看起来很愉快。
[P21] 地嗖头医生为狐狸涂完神秘药水后，要求其咬紧一分钟，结果狐狸的牙齿被粘住无法张开。医生解释这是药水的正常反应，保证狐狸不会再牙痛。
[P22] 狐狸因牙齿被药水粘住无法张开，呆立原地，看着地嗖头医生和太太，只能咬牙发出声音，假装礼貌地向他们道别。
[P23] 狐狸因牙齿被药水粘住而无法张口，迷迷糊糊地下楼离开；地嗖头医生和太太成功逃脱，并互相亲吻后放了一天假。
